name: Pipeline Packaging - St. Louis
old_description: Including both glass and plastic options, Pipeline has bottles and jars for any application. Common options include pharmaceutical glass, food grade packaging and industrial containers.
about:
Pipeline Packaging operates from St. Louis, Missouri, where it was founded in 1988. The company is employee-owned, meaning every team member holds a stake in the business.

The firm distributes a broad line of rigid packaging — glass and plastic bottles and jars, metal and aluminum cans, caps, pumps, sprayers, steel and plastic drums, pails, tubs, and IBC totes — and backs those products with value-added services including custom assembly and decorating, engineering and testing, global sourcing, inventory management, packaging concept development, and warehousing and logistics. Its nine warehouses provide more than 1,000,000 square feet of storage, supported by a network of over 300 domestic and international suppliers.

Customers span pharmaceutical, food and beverage, industrial chemicals, automotive and coatings, agricultural and lawn care, household cleaners, and health and beauty markets. The company also handles hazardous-material packaging and spill-remediation support.

Pipeline positions itself as a flexible alternative to buying direct from manufacturers, offering just-in-time delivery, modified stock packaging, labeling, kitting, and customization without the high-volume minimums typical of factory-direct purchases. The employee-ownership model is cited as a driver of personal accountability and customer service.
